doc.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006

title: Eddie Bert and Lehman College
summary: Brief talk about Eddie Bert on the Mingus date and sitting in at Lehman College.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Eddie Bert was on that group?
Eddie Bert was on that gig. I just saw him recently. He comes and sits in — I’m teaching at Lehman College and he comes down and sits in with the band sometimes. Yeah Eddie Bert was on that gig.
You know it’s funny about Eddie, I’ll bet you he’ll be able to tell you how many miles it is between his house and this Lehman College. Ask him about that.

Oh yeah, oh yeah, no, that was one of his complaints. That’s why he stopped coming because, you know, it’s an hour between my house and here, and it’s an hour back and he’s glued to his watch, and I said yeah, okay.
I just remember about that, he told me what he’s doing now and every gig he mentioned he had the mileage memorized or something. Interesting.
